refusal.detail: The 1H design's section 2 is a screen SHAPE, not a runnable spec: it names the metrics (1H-total MAE, 1H-margin MAE) and one baseline by name, but supplies no verdict rule, no baseline construction, no share estimator, no scored-season set, no inference procedure, and no fixture-universe composition. Running the screen would require the runner to invent all six. Per standing law the screen records NOT_EXECUTABLE with the gaps named; no criterion was edited and no substitute term was adopted. The Oct 28 PBP admission (PR #2901) cleared the design's named data prerequisite — the blocker is now the spec, not the data.

gaps.name: baseline_construction

gaps.name: scored_seasons

gaps.name: inference_procedure
gaps.detail: No bootstrap design, resample count, or seed is declared for the 1H legs.

gaps.name: fixture_universe_composition
gaps.detail: The scored universe composition is unstated: parent three-way-agreed universe (26,553 fixtures in PRs #2891/#2892) intersected with the admission's final-agreement PBP gate, vs schedule universe under the PBP gate alone.

spec_audit.evidence: PR #2901 admission manifest: 9 season files full-tuple pinned, schema verified; manifest 'satisfies' block clears PBP_PREREQUISITE_MISSING for design-screen use of CBB 1H only.
Section 2: '1H outcomes are derived from the pinned PBP itself'; admission record binds Method A (running score) with the final-agreement consumer gate; Method B refused.
Section 2: 'the share is fitted on seasons strictly before each scored season' (walk-forward window stated).

Section 2 contains no CI test, threshold, or pass condition (probe: False). The parent section 3 bar ('CI upper bound < 0 against both baselines on both legs') is written for the spread/total legs only (scoped probe: True) and section 2 does not import it — unlike section 1 for team totals, which imports the section 3 protocol and its CI explicitly (probe: True).
Baseline named (probe: True) but never constructed (probe: False): the text does not state what full-game expectation the climatology scales, nor how the baseline's own share is estimated.

Section 2 fixes 'one share for team points, applied to margin and total alike' but never defines the estimator (probe: False): mean of per-game ratios vs ratio of sums, league-wide vs per-team, treatment of overtime games, and the fitting universe (final-gated PBP vs all PBP games) are all unstated.

Section 2 names no season span (probe: False). The pinned PBP begins 2014-15, so the walk-forward rule leaves the first season's status undecided in the text: scored with an undefined share, or fit-only.

Section 2 declares no bootstrap design, resample count, or seed (probe: False). The parent section 3 season-block bootstrap is written for the spread/total legs; the executed sibling screens' 10,000 reps / seed 20261028 come from those families' own governing texts, not from anything written for 1H.

Section 2 does not state the scored fixture universe (probe: False): whether candidate expectations are computed on the parent screens' three-way-agreed universe intersected with the admission's final-agreement PBP gate, or on the schedule universe under the PBP gate alone, is a composition choice the text never makes.

what_would_unblock: A design amendment for the 1H family — the same instrument that closed the sibling families' G-1/G-2/G-3 (Amendment 2, PR #2906) — supplying: (1) the verdict rule for both legs; (2) the climatology baseline's construction; (3) the share estimator; (4) the scored-season set and the first season's status; (5) the inference procedure (resamples, seed); (6) the fixture-universe composition. Adoption of such an amendment is the owner's recorded act; this packet proposes none of the six terms.
non_effects: No construction was fitted or run; no share was estimated; no criterion, threshold, or leg of any design was edited; the PR #2892 first-half record (NOT_EXECUTABLE — PBP_PREREQUISITE_MISSING) stands as executed at its run time and is superseded only as to its stated reason: the prerequisite it named has since been satisfied, and the screen remains NOT_EXECUTABLE on the new reason recorded here.
